name: Security Event log cleared
source_status: Historical published analytic rule version 1.0.1; intentionally pinned, not asserted to be latest
query:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 1102 and EventSourceName == "Microsoft-Windows-Eventlog" 
| summarize StartTimeUtc = min(TimeGenerated), EndTimeUtc = max(TimeGenerated), EventCount = count() by Computer, Account, EventID, Activity
| extend timestamp = StartTimeUtc, AccountCustomEntity = Account, HostCustomEntity = Computer
source_binding: All fixture records are synthetic rows of SecurityEvent
training_exclusion: Not established. Parent must check overlap against available released data; independent source is not proof of training exclusion.

name: Execution with AT
source_status: Published MITRE CAR analytic, Splunk implementation, Sysmon native data model
query: index=__your_sysmon_index__ Image="C:\\Windows\\*\\at.exe"|stats values(CommandLine) as "Command Lines" by ComputerName
source_binding: The upstream index placeholder is preserved verbatim. All fixture records carry that same index value and are assumed already selected into this source for both arms. Index discrimination is not being tested.
training_exclusion: Not established. Parent must check overlap against available released data; independent source is not proof of training exclusion.
